latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Generator Canva — Create Videos from Images.

- Instantly create 1080p videos from up to five product images and a logo using a simple chat interface.
- No timeline dragging or export settings—just upload images/clips, describe your goals, and get a downloadable video in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports branded video generation for marketers and social creators, including text overlays and music tracks.
- Simple, automatic authentication process with 100 free credits for new users (valid 7 days).
- Robust cloud rendering pipeline with clear feedback, automatic session management, and support for common video/image formats.
- Includes tips, error handling, and workflow guidance for smooth user experience.
